title.narrative: EOSG - A United Nations Fit for the Future: Towards Effective Implementation of the Pact for the Future, Spearheading Our Common Agenda

description.narrative:
Impact: Achieving the Secretary-General’s vision for a multilateralism better suited to the challenges of an interconnected world – including the implementation of the Pact for the Future, the Global Digital Compact, and the Declaration on Future Generations, as well as improved global governance arrangements that ensure an inclusive, effective, and accountable multilateral system capable of tackling both present and future global issues.
Outcome 1: Forge resilient global cooperation and a renewed sense of international solidarity, by streamlining the Secretary-General’s support for delivering on the Pact for the Future and the vision of Our Common Agenda. This includes steering work on key action items and flagship initiatives, such as UN 2.0 and the Secretary-General’s scientific advisory board, alongside furnishing periodic progress updates.
Outcome 2: Strengthen efforts to prevent and resolve conflicts through the New Agenda for Peace and the commitments made in the Pact for the Future, including through the UN Charter’s provisions for mediation, the Secretary-General’s good offices as well as by leveraging the Secretary-General’s Call to Action for Human Rights which emphasizes the importance of the full range of human rights for conflict prevention and sustainable peace. This includes supporting a review on the future of all forms of UN peace operations, providing strategic recommendations and lessons learned, developing protocols for convening and operationalizing emergency platforms, and placing human rights at the center of the work of the United Nations and in the implementation of the Pact.
